title: Twelve Pockets of Christmas
about: Bright red-and-blue twelve-pocket jeans become a wonderfully impractical-looking but useful Christmas surprise.
description: Inspired by a beloved pair of unusually practical jeans, Twelve Pockets of Christmas tells the story of taking an everyday idea to wonderfully ridiculous extremes. With Dillon's love of backpacking in mind, a custom pair of bright red-and-blue pants is designed with pockets for nearly everything including water bottles. What sounds like a joke is also a surprisingly thoughtful handmade gift, and another chapter in the family's tradition of giving presents that nobody will forget.
lyrics: Verse 1
I had a favorite pair of jeans,
The kind you couldn't find,
With pockets tucked in every place,
And storage on my mind.
You could carry half your belongings,
And still have room for more,
A water bottle in your pocket,
Who needs a backpack anymore?And Dillon liked his backpacking,
So I knew just what to do,
I'd make him something practical,
In bright red and blue!Chorus
Twelve pockets, two colors,
A sight you've never seen!
Half of 'em could hold a bottle,
And they're tougher than they seem!
Bright blue, bright red,
From the waist down to the shoes,
They might look like they're made for show,
But they're built for actual use!Verse 2
The denim wasn't subtle,
It was practically a sign,
Two colors shouting louder,
Than a Christmas light display at night.
They looked like something make-believe,
A costume from a show,
But every stitch was made to last,
And every pocket had a role.No ordinary pair of pants,
No boring faded blue,
If you wanted something different,
These would certainly do!Chorus
Twelve pockets, two colors,
A sight you've never seen!
Half of 'em could hold a bottle,
And they're tougher than they seem!
Bright blue, bright red,
From the waist down to the shoes,
They might look like they're made for show,
But they're built for actual use!Verse 3
Now wrapping them was easy,
Or at least it should've been,
But I had another Christmas gift,
That somehow wandered in.
An old familiar horse was waiting,
With a head upon a stick,
And suddenly I had an idea,
That was just a little sick.I pulled those giant pants right on him,
And stood back to admire,
The legs were hanging everywhere,
Like laundry on a wire!Bridge
A horse in oversized trousers,
Red and blue from end to end,
Twelve pockets full of possibilities,
On a four-legged friend!
They weren't designed for horses,
That much was plain to see,
But I couldn't think of better wrapping,
For a Christmas memory!Final Chorus
Twelve pockets, two colors,
And a horse inside the jeans!
The strangest Christmas wrapping,
That you've probably ever seen!
Bright blue, bright red,
And a horse that couldn't move,
They might've looked ridiculous,
But those pants were built for use!Outro
So if you ever need a present,
And you're wondering what to choose,
Make a pair of twelve-pocket pants,
In the brightest red and blue.
And if you've got a horse around,
Well, here's a little clue:
A horse can wear your Christmas wrapping,
Even if it's two sizes too huge!
